_comment: Claude Code Internals skill -- config-aware PreToolUse hook
PURPOSE: When a task involves Claude Code configuration (anything under
.claude/), this PreToolUse hook fires a non-blocking reminder to consult
HOW TO INSTALL: This hook is opt-in. Merge the 'PreToolUse' array below into
the 'hooks' object in ~/.claude/settings.json. This applies to plugin and
manual installs alike -- the plugin does not register it. For a plugin
install, point 'command' at the plugin's cache copy of config-aware-hook.sh.
- Exit 0 + stdout: Tool targets .claude/ -- proceed, stdout injected as additionalContext to model.
- Exit 0 (no output): Tool does not target .claude/ -- silent pass-through.
- Exit 2 would block the tool (NOT used -- we want a nudge, not a gate).
The matcher uses '(Edit|Write|Bash)' to only fire on tools that can
modify files. The script itself does the fine-grained .claude/ path
detection. Read, Grep, Glob are excluded since they are read-only.
